setup.step1Desc: Choose a strong passphrase to encrypt your data. You'll enter this each time you open ThreatCaddy.
setup.step2Desc: Save this recovery key in a secure location. If you forget your passphrase, this is the only way to unlock your data.
setup.savedRecoveryKey: I've saved this recovery key in a secure location
setup.doNotCloseTab: Encrypting your existing data. Do not close this tab.
setup.passphraseMinLength: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
setup.resumePreparation: Reload and unlock to resume safely
settings.metadataNotice: Content and saved copies are encrypted. IDs, tags, timestamps, status, authorship and relationships remain visible as metadata. Encryption does not protect an unlocked browser session.
settings.disableFailed: Data conversion failed; your key and encryption metadata have been retained. Retry to finish: {{error}}
settings.httpsRequired: Encryption requires HTTPS or localhost. It is unavailable over plain HTTP.
settings.sessionEveryLoad: You'll enter your passphrase every time you open ThreatCaddy.
settings.sessionTabClose: Your session stays unlocked until you close the tab.
settings.sessionDuration_desc: Your session stays unlocked for {{duration}} after entering your passphrase.
settings.encryptionDesc: Encrypt your data at rest using AES-256-GCM. You'll set a passphrase to unlock your data (session duration is configurable after setup).
settings.disableDesc: Enter your passphrase to decrypt all data and disable encryption.
settings.newPassMinLength: New passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
passphrase.prepareFailed: Your key was accepted, but preparing the workspace failed: {{error}}. Unlock again to retry.
passphrase.metadataUnavailable: Encryption metadata could not be read. Restore it from a backup before opening this workspace.
passphrase.enterRecoveryKey: Enter your 24-word recovery key to unlock your encrypted data.
passphrase.enterPassphrase: Enter your passphrase to unlock your encrypted data.
passphrase.startFreshWarning: This will permanently delete all your encrypted data (notes, tasks, timelines, etc.). This cannot be undone.
legacy.title: Retained legacy database
legacy.notice: The old BrowserNotes database contains {{count}} historical records outside this workspace’s encryption lifecycle. It may contain readable content. Nothing is removed automatically.
legacy.unverified: Complete and verify the legacy transfer before cleanup. Keep both copies if records conflict.
legacy.passwordMismatch: Recovery archive passwords do not match.
legacy.download: Create and download verified encrypted archive
legacy.savedConfirmation: I saved the encrypted recovery archive and its password somewhere safe.
legacy.deleteConfirmation: I closed all other BrowserNotes tabs and confirm permanent removal of only the old BrowserNotes database. My current workspace is retained.
legacy.blocked: Cleanup is waiting for an old BrowserNotes connection to close. Close other legacy tabs. Deletion has not completed.
legacy.removed: The old BrowserNotes database was removed. Your current workspace and downloaded recovery archive are retained.
legacy.beforeDisable: Before discarding the encryption key, save a verified legacy recovery archive and complete the confirmed legacy cleanup below.
legacy.recoverNotice: Restore a password-encrypted legacy recovery archive into an empty workspace only. Existing records or sync history are never replaced. Use a fresh browser profile if this workspace already contains data.
legacy.recoverConfirmation: I confirm recovery into this empty workspace, including the archive’s original sync history.
legacy.recovered: Verified and restored {{count}} records. Reopen the workspace to finish content upgrades.
legacy.pendingDrafts: Save or recover pending drafts before reopening the workspace.
legacy.archiveTooLarge: This recovery archive exceeds the 512 MiB browser import limit.
